headline: Indian IT services showed uneven growth in Q2 FY27, with AI driving profit gains for some while revenue expansion slowed for others.
summary: Revenue growth ranged from low single digits at Infosys to over 50% at Coforge. Profit margins improved at HCLTech and Coforge, reflecting strong AI‑related earnings. Guidance was trimmed at Infosys but raised at Mphasis. Overall sentiment is positive but mixed on the top‑line.

themes.title: AI‑enabled earnings
themes.detail: AI revenue contributed to profit jumps at HCLTech, Infosys and Mphasis.

themes.title: Revenue growth divergence
themes.detail: Coforge and Tech Mahindra posted double‑digit growth, while Infosys and Wipro lagged.

themes.title: Dividend stability
themes.detail: Most firms maintained or raised interim dividends despite varied earnings.

leaders.why: 53.6% YoY revenue growth and raised EBIT margin guidance to 16%.
21% YoY profit rise powered by $219 m AI revenue.

laggards.why: Revenue growth slowed to ~1% YoY and FY27 guidance cut to 1‑2%.
Revenue grew 9.1% YoY but profit fell 1.9% and headcount reduced.
